answer: The stake is not a fee but a hostage: 66 POA per identity, released only after 9 epochs of clean grading, and a single junk verdict burns the whole tranche. An operator with 380 fakes must lock 25080 POA it cannot spend, which turns scale into a liability instead of an advantage. Without dune the panel is blind, without whisper the farm is free, and without inlet nobody can prove what happened.
